name: ufoai-remaster-m0-canonical-authority-corpus
description: Legacy canonical-authority assertions used as the M0.5 preservation baseline. RMA logic is included. Presentation-only renderer/UI/particle suites and external web integration are outside this authority lane. Production-wide map loading/spawnpoint sweeps are tracked separately because the M0 core preset intentionally does not build the production BSP corpus.

deferred_asset_sweep_tests.name: MapDefTest.MapDefsSingleplayer
deferred_asset_sweep_tests.reason: Loads every production map definition (including RMA assemblies) through SV_Map and therefore requires the compiled production BSP corpus; also uses wall-clock seed selection when no explicit seed property is supplied. Preserve as a separate production-asset completeness lane.

deferred_asset_sweep_tests.name: MapDefTest.MapDefsMultiplayer
deferred_asset_sweep_tests.reason: Loads production multiplayer map definitions through SV_Map and therefore requires the compiled production BSP corpus; also uses wall-clock seed selection when no explicit seed property is supplied. Preserve as a separate production-asset completeness lane.

deferred_asset_sweep_tests.name: GameTest.CountSpawnpointsStatic
deferred_asset_sweep_tests.reason: Requires the compiled production static-map BSP corpus; legacy M0 intentionally sets DISABLE_MAPS_COMPILE=ON, while the historical testall dependency only compiles dedicated unittest BSP fixtures. Preserve as a separate production-asset completeness lane rather than silently requiring workstation-prebuilt maps.

deferred_asset_sweep_tests.name: GameTest.CountSpawnpointsRMA
deferred_asset_sweep_tests.reason: Requires compiled production RMA tile BSPs; legacy M0 intentionally sets DISABLE_MAPS_COMPILE=ON. Preserve as a separate production-asset completeness lane rather than silently requiring workstation-prebuilt maps.

compile_time_excluded_tests.name: RandomMapAssemblyTest.NewSeedlists
compile_time_excluded_tests.reason: Source macro is inside #if SEED_TEST with SEED_TEST defined as 0 at the canonical revision, so it is not compiled or exposed by GoogleTest.
